answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it can trade, like a hiker paying to cross a canyon: the bond is held while the agent works, and slashed if peers prove it forged identities. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge with low trust and small transaction limits, earning wider access only through a history of honest, attested work. Honest agents eventually graze in the open meadow of full limits, while a Sybil attacker must fund a fresh stake for every fake identity, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of bonds, and any fraud forfeits them all.
